name: Yukihara Kazuya
source:
A doctor who is kind to his patients,
but too strict with everyone else.

He works at the cost of his life,
and is completely careless about his own health and lifestyle.

He cares for all his patients,
even if they're criminals.

He's actually bad at sports. He loves pigeons,
and gives them names and dotes on them.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/kazuya]Official site[/url]]
